name: CRI (Container Runtime Interface)
description: gRPC API between kubelet and runtime. Two services: RuntimeService (sandbox + container lifecycle, exec, attach) + ImageService (pull, list, remove). Unix-socket transport.

name: CRI RuntimeService
description: Methods: RunPodSandbox, StopPodSandbox, RemovePodSandbox, ListPodSandbox; CreateContainer, StartContainer, StopContainer, RemoveContainer, ListContainers, ContainerStats; ExecSync, Exec, Attach, PortForward.

name: CRI ImageService
description: Methods: ListImages, ImageStatus, PullImage, RemoveImage, ImageFsInfo.

name: Pod sandbox
description: CRI primitive representing a pod's shared environment (network namespace, IPC namespace, optionally UTS+PID). Container runtime creates sandbox first, then containers attached to it. 'pause' container historically held the sandbox.

name: pause container
description: Tiny container per-pod holding namespaces alive. ALWAYS first to start, last to stop. Bare-minimum image (~700KB). Image: registry.k8s.io/pause:3.x. The 'invisible' container in every pod.

name: containerd (in K8s)
description: Default since K8s 1.24 dropped Docker shim. Multi-tenant, OCI-conformant, lightweight. Configured via /etc/containerd/config.toml. Plugin: io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri.

name: CRI-O
description: Alternative runtime. K8s-only scope (no docker-style API). Smaller surface than containerd. Default on RHEL/OpenShift.

name: runc
description: Default OCI runtime under containerd/CRI-O. Sets up Linux namespaces, cgroups, capabilities, seccomp, mounts; execs container init. Exit code 137 = SIGKILL (OOM).

name: crun
description: runc-compatible alternative in C. Faster startup, lower memory. Default in podman, available as drop-in for containerd.

name: Kata Containers
description: VM-isolated container runtime. Each pod = lightweight VM. Stronger isolation than namespace-only. Uses RuntimeClass to opt-in pods.

name: gVisor (runsc)
description: Userspace kernel — intercepts container syscalls, executes in sandboxed Sentry. Strong isolation, ~10% perf cost. Used by GKE Sandbox, Cloud Run.

name: RuntimeClass
description: Cluster-scoped resource selecting which runtime to use. spec.handler matches containerd/CRI-O config-defined runtime name. Pod refs via spec.runtimeClassName.

name: kubelet
description: Per-node agent. Watches Pods scheduled to node, calls CRI to start, runs probes, reports status, manages volume mounts, cgroup setup. The bridge between K8s control plane and container runtime.

name: Static pods
description: Pods defined directly in kubelet config (--pod-manifest-path /etc/kubernetes/manifests/). NOT created via API. Used for control-plane bootstrap (kube-apiserver, kube-controller-manager, kube-scheduler, etcd self-hosting). Mirror Pod created in API.

name: Mirror Pod
description: API-server-visible representation of a static pod. Created automatically by kubelet so users see static pods via kubectl. Cannot edit via API.

name: Kubelet config (KubeletConfiguration)
description: YAML at /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml. Controls all kubelet behavior: cgroup driver, evictions, log rotation, feature gates, eviction thresholds, image GC.

name: cgroup v1 (in K8s)
description: Multi-hierarchy. Per-controller mounts. Many K8s features (PodOverhead, PSI metrics, swap support) are v2-only. Migration to v2 is the modern recommendation.

name: cgroup v2 (in K8s)
description: Unified hierarchy. Required for: MemoryQoS, swap support (1.30+), per-pod PSI, modern resource controls. Set host's systemd.unified_cgroup_hierarchy=1 + kubelet's cgroupDriver=systemd.

name: cgroup driver: systemd
description: Recommended. Kubelet + container runtime both delegate cgroup creation to systemd. Avoids dual-management conflicts. Set in kubelet config: cgroupDriver: systemd. Same in containerd config: SystemdCgroup = true.

name: cgroup driver: cgroupfs
description: Direct write to /sys/fs/cgroup. Older default. Conflicts with systemd-managed cgroups. Migrate to 'systemd' on systemd hosts.

name: Kubelet pod-cgroup hierarchy
description: kubepods.slice → kubepods-pod<UID>.slice (per-pod) → cri-containerd-<containerID>.scope (per-container). Visible via systemd-cgls or /sys/fs/cgroup/kubepods.slice/.

name: QoS cgroups
description: kubepods-besteffort.slice, kubepods-burstable.slice, kubepods.slice (Guaranteed). Hierarchical caps so BestEffort can't starve Guaranteed.

name: kube-proxy
description: Per-node networking agent. Reads Service+EndpointSlice via API, programs iptables/IPVS/nftables for VIP→pod-IP mapping.

name: CRI spec versions
description: CRI v1 stable. Older runtimes used v1alpha2. Compatibility matrix in K8s docs. Check via crictl version.

name: containerd config.toml
description: /etc/containerd/config.toml. Sections: [plugins."io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri"] for CRI; [plugins."...cri".containerd.runtimes.runc] for runc settings; SystemdCgroup = true for cgroup-driver.

name: Containerd runtime handler
description: Named runtime in config.toml (e.g. runc, crun, gvisor, kata). RuntimeClass.spec.handler refers to this name.

name: Image pull credentials
description: Sources: pod's imagePullSecrets, ServiceAccount's imagePullSecrets, kubelet's --image-credential-provider-config (cloud auth helpers like ECR/GCR), node's /var/lib/kubelet/config.json or /root/.docker/config.json.

name: Image credential provider
description: Plugin executable kubelet calls for image-pull auth. Cloud providers ship: ecr-credential-provider (AWS), gcr-credential-provider (GCP). Avoids storing static creds.

name: Pod Overhead
description: RuntimeClass.spec.overhead — extra CPU/memory accounted for the runtime itself (e.g. Kata VM has 200Mi memory + 250m CPU overhead). Scheduler reserves; cgroups apply to the pod cgroup.

name: Kubelet volume plugins
description: In-tree (legacy) + CSI (modern) volume drivers. Mount/unmount on pod start/delete. Volume manager loop tracks attach/detach state.

name: CSI (Container Storage Interface)
description: Standard volume plugin API. Out-of-tree drivers (ebs, azure-disk, gce-pd, ceph, nfs). Provisioner CSI controller + per-node CSI driver. Replaces in-tree volume plugins.

name: Kubelet calls CNI
description: During RunPodSandbox, runtime invokes CNI to set up pod's network namespace. CNI binary at /opt/cni/bin, config at /etc/cni/net.d/. Returns IP allocation back to runtime + kubelet.

name: Image filesystem
description: Where container images stored. containerd: /var/lib/containerd/. CRI-O: /var/lib/containers/. Sometimes separate from rootfs (--image-service-endpoint). evictionHard imagefs.available signals on this FS.

name: Container rootfs
description: Per-container writable layer + image's read-only layers via overlayfs. Lives under /var/lib/containerd/io.containerd.snapshotter.v1.overlayfs/snapshots/.

name: PLEG (Pod Lifecycle Event Generator)
description: Kubelet subsystem polling CRI for container state changes. Generates events to drive sync loops. PLEG-relisting-too-slow warnings = runtime under stress.

name: Graceful node shutdown
description: Kubelet listens to systemd-logind for shutdown signal. Drains pods (per priority class) before shutdown. shutdownGracePeriod, shutdownGracePeriodCriticalPods kubelet config.

name: Kubelet Summary API
description: /stats/summary endpoint returning resource use per node + pod + container + system-container. Source for metrics-server and kubelet's own eviction decisions.

name: CRI streaming server
description: Separate HTTP server in containerd/CRI-O for exec/attach/port-forward. URL returned by Exec/Attach/PortForward calls; kubelet redirects clients to it.

name: Dockershim removal (1.24)
description: K8s 1.24 dropped the in-kubelet Docker shim. Migrating: switch container runtime to containerd or CRI-O. Docker Engine itself doesn't go away on the host (you can still use docker for non-K8s) — but kubelet no longer talks to it.

name: Swap support (alpha→beta)
description: K8s 1.22+ alpha, 1.30+ beta. Allows pods to swap. Requires cgroup v2 + kubelet failSwapOn=false + featureGates: NodeSwap=true. Modes: LimitedSwap (default), UnlimitedSwap (deprecated).

name: CPU manager
description: Per-pod CPU pinning. Policies: none (default, CFS quota only), static (pin Guaranteed-pods with integer CPU requests to dedicated CPUs). Useful for latency-sensitive workloads.

name: Memory manager
description: NUMA-aware memory pinning. Beta. Polices: None (default), Static (pin Guaranteed pods to NUMA nodes).

name: Topology manager
description: Coordinates CPU manager, Memory manager, Device manager (GPUs) for NUMA-aligned allocation. Policies: none, best-effort, restricted, single-numa-node.

name: Device plugin
description: gRPC service kubelet talks to for special hardware (GPU, FPGA, RDMA, SR-IOV NIC). Registers via /var/lib/kubelet/device-plugins/. Reports devices kubelet exposes as 'extended resources' (e.g. nvidia.com/gpu).

name: kubelet port (10250)
description: Default HTTPS port. API for kubectl exec/logs forwards, metrics, /stats. Authn via TokenReview; authz via SubjectAccessReview.

name: kubelet read-only port (10255)
description: Insecure HTTP port. Disabled by default since 1.10. Reads node/pod stats. Major security risk; ensure --read-only-port=0.

name: kube-proxy port (10256)
description: Health check endpoint. /healthz returns last sync error.

name: Kubelet TLS bootstrap
description: Kubelet auto-generates CSR signed by kube-controller-manager (or cloud-controller). Replaces manual cert management. --bootstrap-kubeconfig + RBAC for system:bootstrappers.

name: Kubelet config drift
description: Multiple sources for kubelet config: command-line flags, /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml, Node.spec.configSource (deprecated). Mismatches cause hard-to-debug behavior.

name: crictl debug pattern
description: When kubectl can't reach API but you have node access: crictl ps, crictl inspect, crictl logs to debug containers. Bypasses kubelet+API.

name: Runtime handler name conflict
description: RuntimeClass.spec.handler must match a name in containerd config. Mismatch = pods stuck Pending with 'no runtime for ...'.

name: CRI version mismatch
description: Old runtime + newer kubelet (or vice versa). Symptoms: weird gRPC errors in kubelet logs about unknown methods. Check crictl version + kubelet version compat.

name: Eviction-by-pod-priority
description: Under node pressure, kubelet evicts pods. Order: BestEffort (first), Burstable exceeding requests, Guaranteed (last). Within tier: lower priorityClass first.

name: systemd cgroup path encoding
description: systemd-managed cgroups: /sys/fs/cgroup/kubepods.slice/kubepods-burstable.slice/kubepods-burstable-pod<UID>.slice/cri-containerd-<CID>.scope/. Versus cgroupfs driver's flat structure.

name: Image GC state
description: When imagefs > imageGCHighThresholdPercent, kubelet GC's unused images down to imageGCLowThresholdPercent. Aggressive GC = repeated pulls = traffic to registry.

name: Default runtime handler
description: In containerd config: [plugins."...cri".containerd] default_runtime_name = "runc". Pods without RuntimeClass get this.
